        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        
        # Compute Stirling numbers of the second kind up to n
        max_n = n
        stirling = [[0] * (i + 1) for i in range(max_n + 1)]
        stirling[0][0] = 1
        for i in range(1, max_n + 1):
            for j in range(1, i + 1):
                stirling[i][j] = (j * stirling[i-1][j] + stirling[i-1][j-1]) % MOD
        
        # Compute factorials and inverse factorials up to x
        max_fact = x
        fact = [1] * (max_fact + 1)
        for i in range(1, max_fact + 1):
            fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i % MOD
        
        inv_fact = [1] * (max_fact + 1)
        inv_fact[max_fact] = pow(fact[max_fact], MOD - 2, MOD)
        for i in range(max_fact - 1, -1, -1):
            inv_fact[i] = inv_fact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % MOD
        
        total = 0
        for k in range(1, x + 1):
            if k > n:
                continue
            # Calculate combination C(x, k) mod MOD
            comb = fact[x] * inv_fact[k] % MOD
            comb = comb * inv_fact[x - k] % MOD
            s = stirling[n][k]
            f = fact[k]
            y_pow = pow(y, k, MOD)
            term = comb * s % MOD
            term = term * f % MOD
            term = term * y_pow % MOD
            total = (total + term) % MOD
        
        return total
